reference_role: Each element's master-baby.png was used as its exact lineage and visual-style reference.
shared_prompt: Create exactly one intact upright dinosaur egg that unmistakably belongs to the referenced Baby lineage. Preserve the Baby's limited palette, signature markings, outline weight, pixel density and upper-left lighting, translated onto an eggshell design. The egg must remain clearly an egg, not a miniature dinosaur. Authentic hand-pixeled 16-bit pixel art, crisp hard pixel clusters, limited palette, consistent dark outline, no antialiasing or painterly texture. Single centered egg, front or very slight three-quarter view, complete silhouette occupying about 58-64% of the square safe envelope, bottom resting on one shared baseline, generous margin on all sides. Perfectly flat solid #FF00FF background. Shell fully intact with no crack, hole, hatchling or broken shell pieces. Any ornament must be small and physically attached to the shell. No detached effects, particles, nest, floor, shadow, reflection, scenery, frame, grid, text, UI, watermark or extra object. Nothing touches the edge. Do not use #FF00FF inside the egg.

lineage_designs.neutral: Olive-green and warm ochre shell, cream lower accents, mottled Stegosaurus-family spots and a tidy row of tiny amber plate-shaped crown ridges.
lineage_designs.fire: Charcoal-black shell, lava-red fissure markings, warm cream lower accents, two tiny Carnotaurus horn nubs and low ember-orange crown ridges.
lineage_designs.grass: Fresh leaf-green shell, cream lower panel, darker vine curls and leaf-scale motifs, one tiny sprout and attached leaf-shaped crown ridges.
lineage_designs.ground: Sandstone and ochre shell with layered pebble armor plates and a flat tail-club emblem.
lineage_designs.electric: Golden-yellow shell, cobalt-blue zigzag markings, white lower accent and one compact backward lightning-crest ridge.
lineage_designs.water: Deep blue shell, cyan scales, cream lower accent, turquoise wave bands and one small attached sail-like crown fin.
lineage_designs.ice: Pale ice-blue and white shell, frosted speckles, snowflake marking and a compact crown of crystalline plates.
lineage_designs.dragon: Crimson-red shell, dark volcanic scale markings, antique-gold lower plates, two swept-back horn nubs and low golden dorsal ridges.
lineage_designs.dark: Midnight navy-black shell, feather-scale texture, pale silver eye-mask curve and crescent markings, with a compact attached feather crest.
